items.q: Tito Guizar, who had this tobacco plantation -- he happened to be down in South America, and they decided that they would put on a show to raise some money to get this boat off of Tito Guizar's

ctx.x: You mean out of it and into something else or just out of it?

Out of it. Period: Lloyd Nolan was the captain of this boat. And they were riding down the Mississippi, and they got stranded on somebody's lawn. Tito Guizar, who had this tobacco plantation -- he happened to be down in South America, and they decided that they would put on a show to raise some money to get this boat off of Tito Guizar's
